labelling.pass_1: authored item, quote and key points directly from the source document text
labelling.pass_2: mechanical grounding check: every salient token of every key point must occur in the item's own evidence quotes
labelling.residual_detail: g-009: the source PDF renders 'beneficiaries' as 'benefi ciaries', so the key point cannot be token-matched against its own quote. Disclosed rather than reworded to force a pass.
labelling.disclosure: Author and reviewer are the same agent. Per EVAL_PROTOCOL.md §2.1 and U-17 this is SELF-AGREEMENT, not inter-rater reliability. No Cohen's kappa is reported here and none may be computed from these two passes. Human double-labelling under §5 has not been performed.

known_limits: Built from the 21-document Phase 0 corpus. C-3 and C-5 (corpus breadth) remain undecided, so topical coverage is narrow.
ADR-0003 overlaps adjacent chunks by 150 characters, so a quote near a boundary resolves to two chunks and either is a correct citation. 150 citation IDs across 131 answerable items.
No LLM judge has scored these items; U-1 is unresolved and no API keys exist. Only deterministic scorers can run.
